## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T1789 in four fascicles is one of the three "imperially-decreed commentaries" (御製註解) of Hóngwǔ 11 (1378), produced by the Línjì Chán abbot [宗泐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%B3%90) (1318–1390) of the Tiānjièshànshìchánsì 天界善世禪寺 in tandem with the Tiāntái scholar [如玘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E7%8E%98) (1320–1385) of the Yǎnfújiàosì 演福教寺. The commentary is on *[Léngqié ābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670, the four-fascicle [求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) *Laṅkāvatāra*) — the version of the *Laṅkāvatāra* with the strongest Chán-school affiliation.

**Abstract**

T1789 is paired with the *Heart-Sūtra* and *Diamond-Sūtra* commentaries that [宗泐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%B3%90) and [如玘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E7%8E%98) produced in the same Hóngwǔ 11 imperial commission ([T1714](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0141) = the *Heart-Sūtra* commentary; the *Diamond-Sūtra* commentary). Their *Laṅkāvatāra* commentary is methodologically distinctive in two respects: (i) it is paragraph-by-paragraph, with the Sòng-period Chán reading of the sūtra (originating with Bodhidharma's transmission to Huìkě) given priority over the Yogācāra-doctrinal reading characteristic of [菩提流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF)'s and [實叉難陀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%A6%E5%8F%89%E9%9B%A3%E9%99%80)'s recensions; (ii) it is doctrinally syncretic, drawing on Tiāntái categories from [如玘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%A6%82%E7%8E%98)'s scholastic background and Chán readings from [宗泐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%B3%90)'s — characteristic of the late-Yuán / early-Míng cross-school synthesis.

The *zhùjiě* genre is markedly elementary by comparison with [T1791](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0334) of [寶臣](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AF%B6%E8%87%A3) (a Sòng commentary on T672), reflecting the imperial commission's intended audience: monks and lay readers throughout the new Míng dynasty's saṅgha rather than the Tiāntái or Chán scholastic specialist. The Hóngwǔ emperor's preface (preserved in the Taishō and elsewhere) explicitly frames the project as making the *Laṅkāvatāra* widely accessible.

Note on names: the catalog meta records the second author with a Unicode private-use-area glyph (如󰃗); the standard form, confirmed by both the imperial record at the head of T1789 and by DILA Authority A000334, is 如玘 (Rúqǐ).

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); paired imperial commentaries [KR6c0141](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0141) (心經註解 / T1714) and the *Diamond-Sūtra* commentary T1703.
